environment.description: Terraform provider runs on an EC2 instance in a private subnet (10.0.128.0/24) within the same VPC. The subnet's route table has only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no NAT gateway, VPC endpoint for S3/DynamoDB only (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3, com.amazonaws.us-east-1.dynamodb), and no other interface endpoints. Security group allows egress only to the GraphQL service CIDR (10.0.2.0/24:8080). The GraphQL service itself runs in 10.0.2.0/24. DNS resolution is handled by Route53 private hosted zone. No internet-facing path exists from this subnet. VPC flow logs confirm zero traffic to non-RFC1918 destinations.
